newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - ABN Amro initiates Metrogas.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ABN Amro initiates Metrogas.

text.p: ABN Amro analyst Myles McDougall said Friday he had initiated coverage of Argentina's Metrogas with a "buy" recommendation.
- McDougall said after three years of falling or flat earnings, 1997 will be a "turnaround year for Metrogas," with a 25.2 percent earnings increase predicted for the year.
- The 12-month ADR target price is $11, up 12.8 percent from the current price of $9.75, .
- Earnings per ADR are forecast at $0.93 this year, $1.12 in 1998 and $1.27 in 1999 from $0.74 last year.

- The 25.2. percent increase in revenue and a three year rise in the CAGR (compound annual growth rate) of 19.5 percent "is based on a combination of factors including: a redution in transportation costs and non-technical losses, a favorable shift from gas sales to higher margin pure distribution services, a moderate rebound in commercial and industrial gas demand and continued cost control," said McDougall.
